sermon.title: The Holy Spirit’s Supernatural Power 12/24/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: On Christmas Eve, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Mark 16 that Jesus sent believers to preach the gospel, not apologetics, and that signs follow believers who share it. He explains casting out devils by the Spirit of God, tells how the Holy Ghost corrected his own early theatrics, contrasts the Spirit with the apostles and in them, and closes with the power of the Lord present to heal.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Names of other ministers are in the transcript only. Garbled terms marked [unclear] (e.g. the “seven sons of [unclear]”—Sceva in Acts 19). Point to check: “15 different languages” on Pentecost (32:20). Sensitive content kept as spoken: unbelievers “gonna burn in the lake of fire forever”; Muslims, Mormons, Catholic church; Catholic exorcism ritual “a bunch of baloney”; “demons don’t have names”; ministers “running off with the church’s secretary”; church members “shacking up … smoking marijuana.”

faqs.question: What does Mark 16:15 command?
faqs.answer: Go preach the gospel to every creature.

faqs.question: What did Jesus tell the woman’s accusers?
faqs.answer: He who is without sin, cast the first stone.

faqs.question: Who shall be saved, Mark 16:16?
faqs.answer: He that believes and is baptized.

faqs.question: What is the power of God unto salvation?
By what did Jesus cast out devils?
Is there a ritual for casting out demons?
faqs.answer: No; it’s by the Holy Spirit.

faqs.question: What did the demon tell the seven sons?
faqs.answer: Jesus I know, Paul I know, but who are you?

faqs.question: What was present in Luke 5:17?
faqs.answer: The power of the Lord to heal.
